packs.name: Encrypted Multi-device Chat
packs.description: Use explicitly allowed Matrix rooms for encrypted self-handoff, links, messages, and workspace attachments without exposing account credentials to the agent.

capabilities.name: Encrypted-chat compatibility
capabilities.description: Inspect pinned Matrix server, SDK, transport, desktop, and Android client compatibility without starting a session or exposing credential paths.

capabilities.name: Opaque room access catalog
capabilities.description: List only explicitly agent-allowed accounts and rooms using stable opaque user, device, homeserver, and room references.

capabilities.name: Previewed encrypted message and file send
capabilities.description: Create a hash-bound, visibly attributed message plan and send only after approval, room-encryption proof, scope checks, and attachment readback.

capabilities.name: Bounded encrypted room history
capabilities.description: Read a bounded tail from one explicitly readable encrypted room while sanitizing tokens, credentials, raw identifiers, and transport metadata.

packs.name: Private Password Vault and Secret Broker
packs.description: Use explicitly scoped Vaultwarden secrets through opaque, one-time, destination-bound leases without placing decrypted values in agent context, arguments, logs, chat, or receipts.

capabilities.name: Vault compatibility and broker policy
capabilities.description: Inspect the pinned Vaultwarden and Bitwarden CLI OSS stack, integrity state, and safe-use policy without returning session references or private storage paths.

capabilities.name: Opaque secret-handle catalog
capabilities.description: List only agent-allowed opaque handles, account availability, and fixed destinations while hiding vault item IDs, session keys, and client state paths.

capabilities.name: One-time secret use
capabilities.description: Plan, approve, inject, or revoke a short-lived lease bound to one handle, destination, operation, worker, and executable hash without clipboard or secret-bearing process arguments.

capabilities.name: Content-free secret-use audit
capabilities.description: Read bounded use, failure, policy-violation, and revocation receipts containing identity and scope but never a session key, item ID, or secret value.

packs.name: Private P2P Object Cache and Fast Context
packs.description: Store immutable workspace objects and context chunks in a local BLAKE3 CAS for bounded offline reads, with Iroh selected for encrypted peer transfer and replication.

capabilities.name: Local and peer-cache compatibility
capabilities.description: Inspect the local CAS, bounded index, selected Iroh protocol versions, private relay policy, and honest remote-sidecar readiness.

capabilities.name: Immutable object import
capabilities.description: Hash-preview, approve, copy, verify, deduplicate, pin, and index a workspace object without network activity.

capabilities.name: Allowlisted peer object fetch
capabilities.description: Preview and approve a BLAKE3 object fetch from an opaque peer reference, transfer it over authenticated Iroh QUIC, and atomically admit it only after local integrity verification.

capabilities.name: Bounded local context read
capabilities.description: Read a bounded text range from the local CAS without a remote round trip, re-verifying content if indexed file metadata changed.

capabilities.name: Supervised private object publication
capabilities.description: Preview, approve, activate, reload, stop, inspect, and audit a hash-pinned Iroh provider for immutable local objects, with fixed peer identities and broker-only transport offers.

packs.name: Continuous Folder Synchronization
packs.description: Plan, configure, observe, pause, activate, and recover selected peer folders through Syncthing without exposing credentials or silently enabling deletion propagation.

capabilities.name: Continuous-sync health and events
capabilities.description: Read cached service, folder, peer-route, transfer, conflict, and bounded event health with stable device references instead of raw transport identifiers.

capabilities.name: Safe folder relationship planning
capabilities.description: Preview a workspace-scoped, hash-bound relationship with send-only, receive-only, or bidirectional behavior, ignore rules, versioning, peer membership, and deletion risks before changing configuration.

capabilities.name: Permissioned folder lifecycle
capabilities.description: Apply relationships paused, activate only with deletion-propagation approval, pause data movement, rescan bounded paths, compensate partial configuration failures, and retain receipts.

capabilities.name: Explicit conflict recovery
capabilities.description: Run send-only override or receive-only revert only after mode validation, external-side-effect approval, and exact folder-ID confirmation.

packs.name: Nearby Sharing
packs.description: Discover nearby trusted devices and send workspace files through a previewed, recipient-approved, hash-bound LocalSend transaction.

capabilities.name: Nearby device discovery
capabilities.description: Discover LocalSend-compatible LAN devices during a bounded window and retain their HTTPS certificate fingerprints.

capabilities.name: Nearby file transfer
capabilities.description: Preview and send workspace files with exact sizes and SHA-256 values, recipient acceptance, pinned TLS identity, parallel streaming, cancellation, and durable receipts.

capabilities.name: Private peer health

capabilities.name: Private route probe
capabilities.description: Measure a bounded peer route and distinguish direct, peer-relay, relay, and unreachable states.

capabilities.name: Private service discovery
capabilities.description: List, advertise, or revoke credential-free private endpoints for context, artifacts, modules, chat, vault, sharing, sync, and workers.

capabilities.name: Mesh provider migration
capabilities.description: Evaluate the fail-closed migration gates between the current transport bridge and Neyvia's selected self-hosted control plane.

packs.name: Marketplace Trust and Isolation

capabilities.name: Signed module verification

capabilities.name: Isolated WebAssembly module execution

capabilities.name: Module software bill of materials

capabilities.name: Module vulnerability policy
capabilities.description: Scan an independently generated SBOM with a locally cached vulnerability database and fail closed at the configured severity threshold.

capabilities.name: Module malware scan
capabilities.description: Scan an immutable archive or quarantined payload with the installed operating-system antivirus in no-remediation verification mode.
